title: Character Prompt Builder Prompt Dialects
description: Evidence-scoped guidance for a selected tag workflow: spelling, useful block order, model controls and vocabulary sources to consult. A model record selects its dialect and lookup scope; a dialect is not an execution binding or a claim about every derivative's training data.

vocabularies.description: Vocabulary IDs used for dictionary lookup in this dialect. These are lookup and usage scopes, not assertions that every model was trained on those corpora or that unlisted wording is forbidden.

tag_separator.description: What sits between two tags, written out.

multi_word_tags.description: How a tag of more than one word is spelled on this family.

artist_tag_form.description: How an artist tag is written on this family.

weight_range.description: An authored trial range for explicit numeric weights, low then high. The selected interface must support the syntax, and exact model evidence determines whether this range is appropriate.

block_order.description: A useful rendition order under the stated evidence. Exact model and interface guidance may supersede the family baseline; this order is not a semantic completeness test.

quality_terms.description: Quality-control candidates under the stated model or version scope. This list is not a mandatory positive prefix.

rating_terms.description: The family's content-register terms, retained as guidance for the author's rendition.

period_terms.description: The family's terms for a slice of the corpus by date, retained as authored model guidance.

meta_terms.description: Other documented model controls, such as image metadata tags, under the evidence and version scope in this dialect.

dataset_terms.description: Documented dataset or source-selection controls. These are model tokens, not vocabulary resource IDs.

inert_terms.description: Terms without an established role as controls in the stated family evidence. This is caution metadata, not a claim that the text has no possible effect or a prohibition on descriptive use.

negative_form.description: How this family writes a source the negative-policy resource activates.
